caseHistory.description: Every letter, payment and step in this case, oldest first.

clock.description: Skip time forward to see reminders and follow-up letters. Only your account is affected.
telegram.connected: Connected ✓ Send letters to the bot
landing.title: Daunting US compliance, made easy.
landing.subtitle: Ledger is an agent that reads every notice, tracks every deadline, and manages follow-ups, so you can focus on building your dream.
landing.ctaNote: Free hackathon prototype · Payments use a sandbox bank with fake money
landing.docsLabel: Already handling notices from the IRS, Alameda County and the City of Oakland
landing.promise.read.title: Reads every notice
landing.promise.read.body: Snap a photo or upload a PDF, on the web or in Telegram. Ledger finds the sender, the issue, the amount and the deadline, and explains it in your language.
landing.promise.track.title: Tracks every deadline
landing.promise.track.body: Every due date lands on one calendar, with reminders before anything is late.
landing.promise.manage.title: Manages follow-ups
landing.promise.manage.body: It checks your bank, pays with your OK, writes your phone call for you, and follows up until it's done.
landing.demoTitle: From scary notice to done, in one chat.
landing.demoQuestion: What is this? Do I have to pay it?
landing.demoTool.verify: Checking it really comes from the IRS
landing.demoTool.bank: Looking in your bank for a payment
landing.demoReply: This is a real IRS notice (CP14). It says you owe $1,284.00 in 2025 taxes. I didn't find a payment in your bank. Pay by November 18 to stop more interest and penalties. I can pay it now if you approve.
landing.productsTitle: All of your compliance, not just the mail.
landing.product.answer.title: Handle anything the government sends you
landing.product.answer.point1: Pulls out the sender, the issue, the amount and the deadline
landing.product.answer.point2: Checks it's real against the agency's official site
landing.product.answer.point3: Explains it in plain words, in your language
landing.product.answer.point4: Lays out your options: pay, dispute, or ask for a payment plan
landing.product.open.title: Get legal to open, and stay open
landing.product.open.body: Seller's permits, business licenses and health permits.
landing.product.open.point1: A permit checklist for your city and business, with official links
landing.product.open.point3: English answers ready to paste into forms
landing.product.shield.title: Protect your money and your signature
landing.product.shield.body: Loans, leases, contracts, lawyer letters and invoices.
landing.product.shield.point1: Flags risky terms like daily withdrawals and personal guarantees
landing.product.shield.point2: Shows what a loan really costs you
landing.product.shield.point3: Drafts the questions to ask, in English
landing.product.shield.point4: Stops a payment when an invoice's bank account changes
landing.feature.scam.title: Scam check
landing.feature.scam.body: Fake IRS notices are everywhere. Ledger checks the sender, the phone numbers and the addresses against the real agency, and warns you before you pay or call.
landing.feature.paid.title: Already paid?
landing.feature.paid.body: Ledger looks in your bank first, so you never pay the same bill twice.
landing.feature.pay.title: Pay with one tap
landing.feature.pay.body: Nothing moves without your approval. Approve, confirm, done.
landing.feature.call.title: Your call script
landing.feature.call.body: Need to call an agency? Get what to say in English, with the translation right next to it.
landing.feature.remind.title: Never miss a deadline
landing.feature.remind.body: Every due date lands on your calendar, and a notification reaches you before it's late.
landing.feature.memory.title: Remembers your cases
landing.feature.memory.body: A second notice about the same problem? Ledger links it to the first one and knows what's already done.
landing.languagesBody: Ledger reads the English paperwork and answers you in your language. Switch any time.
landing.finalTitle: Focus on your dream. Ledger handles the paperwork.
landing.finalBody: Sign in with Google and send your first notice in under a minute.
landing.disclaimer: Ledger can make mistakes. Check before approving payments.
